subject: Post-discovery: coordinate 30-minute product intro and SME nomination
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@stratos.ai>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@stratos.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jul 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: coordinate 30-minute product intro and SME nomination

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery:
- Primary goals: reduce inference latency for synchronous features and cut per-token costs on batch jobs.
- Key constraints: PCI scope for payments data, EU region preference for training/embeddings.

Proposed next step: a focused 30-minute product intro where we can show a short walkthrough of the runtime, routing policies, and how caching/batching would map to your workloads. We recommend including a technical SME from your infra team (to look at VPC/network questions) and your data/platform lead.

I have three short windows available below — please pick the one that works best for your group, or share two alternatives and I’ll lock in the calendar: 
1) Wed Aug 7, 09:00–09:30 PT (16:00–16:30 UTC)
2) Thu Aug 8, 13:00–13:30 PT (20:00–20:30 UTC)
3) Fri Aug 9, 10:30–11:00 PT (17:30–18:00 UTC)

I attached a one-page mutual action plan and a high-level architecture diagram that we referenced on the call (see attachment stubs). If helpful, here’s my Calendly to pick directly: https://calendly.com/rishi-redwood/30min

Prep we’ll do on our side: short demo tailored to the latency/cost tradeoffs you mentioned and a 5-minute Q&A on private deployment options.

Thanks — looking forward to locking something in.

Best,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf (PDF, 42KB); arch-diagram-stacks.png (PNG, 180KB)

From: Alex Green <alex.green@stratos.ai>

Date: Mon, 29 Jul 2024 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: coordinate 30-minute product intro and SME nomination

Rishi —

Appreciate the summary. We can do Wed Aug 7 at 09:00 PT. I’ll bring our infra lead (Samir Rao) for the VPC/network questions; Priya will join for product/metrics.

Two quick asks for the session:
1) Can you show us how the KV cache would behave for our typical 1.2k token prompts?
2) If you have a short slide on residency/compliance controls for EU customers, please include it.

I’ll wait for the calendar invite.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Green
Head of ML Platforms | Stratos AI
